verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Ghostty ships hundreds of built-in themes, each selectable with one config line. Themes switch automatically with the system dark/light mode, and users can write their own. Community comments praise related color config such as minimum-contrast and selection colors, and mention a `window-theme = system` setting. Missing for 10: reference-level docs on the light/dark theme config syntax, and independent hands-on confirmation that automatic light/dark switching works.
